We understand that your complaint is about a missed connection that left you and your companion animal frustrated and unsure about what happens next.

Thank you for writing to the Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways. We know how stressful it is when travel plans do not go smoothly, especially when a pet is part of the journey, and we appreciate that you reached out with the details so we can look at this carefully. Our team reviews these situations in a calm, step by step way, and we work with the same goal every time: to make sure the next move is clear and that the travel experience is handled with care and respect.

<<FACT F116>> 

We also want to address the issue tied to the delayed departure. <<FACT F109>> 

Based on what you shared, the delay appears to have affected the connection and added avoidable stress. We are sorry for that. When a journey is disrupted, we expect everyone involved to keep communication prompt and respectful, and we try to return that same standard to you in our reply. If there were any instructions from the crew that did not come through clearly, or if you were given conflicting guidance at the gate, we would like to know that as part of the review. That helps us confirm what happened and whether any follow up with the operations team is needed.

For next steps, please keep any supporting travel records together, including booking details, baggage or pet handling tags, and any notes you received during the disruption. If you have already shared those materials, your file can move forward without extra delay. If not, sending them in one message will help us keep the review organized and avoid unnecessary back and forth. We treat each journey as a shared responsibility, and that includes looking closely at both the inconvenience you experienced and the care owed to your animal companion.

We cannot undo the disruption, but we can make sure the concern is handled properly and that your report is reviewed with attention. If there is anything else you want us to consider, especially about how the delay affected your pet's comfort or your transfer plans, please include it in your reply so we can add it to the case notes. Thank you for giving us the chance to look into this and for flying with Aurelia Skyways.

Companion Animal Travel Desk
